title: Kind Friends Come to Sit
traveler_why: Willow is the Traveler whose gift is noticing who is hurting and staying close, and tonight Job’s friends sit beside him in silence for seven days: Willow sits down beside her crying friend with the scraped knee and holds her hand until she feels better.
traveler_about: Willow fits tonight because she notices who is hurting and stays close. In Willow’s world today: Willow’s friend fell down and scraped her knee and started to cry. Willow didn’t know how to fix it, so she just sat beside her friend and held her hand until she felt better. Just like Job’s friends sat quietly with him, Willow learned that being near someone who is sad is a gift of love.
